Adentro, formerly Zenreach (renamed 2021), WiFi-based marketing for physical businesses (San Francisco; zenreach folds into this row). Alice (thisisalice.com), automated pre-tax spending benefits (New York in the firm's page, https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2019-30-index?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.baincapitalventures.com%2Fportfolio%2Falice%2F&output=json; 'a Brooklyn-based HR-tech startup' that had raised a seed round, https://technical.ly/startups/alice-fintech-startup-payroll-benefits/). AI recruiting assistant (Sunnyvale, later Mountain View). Pain-medication monitoring laboratory (Baltimore; lab in Greensboro, NC). API monitoring (Seattle).
